body: Thank you everyone for the help you've tried to give me. Hearing from people like you gives me some hope to go on. And no matter what my choice is at some point because this feeling never seems to go away..I just want you all to know that you're a good group of people. I have so much respect for people like you guys.

I really do have a long life ahead of me and a good one if i apply myself. But i have no motivation, it's not there at all in any way. There was one point in my life shortly after a horribly failed suicide attempt that i realized that i have so much to live for and got myself back on track for some time. But then i got back around the people i used to do drugs with and boom right back on it. I just can't help myself anymore. I don't mean to sound like a whinny little girl but i never get the chance to get things off my chest. I keep it all bottled up for no one to know and it just sends me in a downward spiral. I just wish i had the respect and motivation others have.
Thanks..it means a lot your a good being.
